name: akshare_discover
label: akshare_discover
description: Find and verify a configured/native Python with compatible existing AKShare; readonly reuse first, never download or upgrade shared environments.

name: akshare_status
label: akshare_status
description: Inspect optional AKShare environment. Never installs or downloads anything.

name: akshare_prepare
label: akshare_prepare
description: First verify/reuse compatible existing AKShare. If missing, explicitly create a private plugin-data Python venv and download pinned AKShare 1.19.1 packages from official PyPI. No global/system package install.

python_path.description: Optional native 64-bit Python >=3.11 executable compatible with this host OS

name: akshare_catalog
label: akshare_catalog
description: Discover read-only whitelisted AKShare interfaces and their source/units. No arbitrary Python.

name: akshare_query
label: akshare_query
description: Call a read-only whitelisted research interface; returns actual source rows or a clear network error. Financial numbers are decimal strings, never synthetic fallback.

name: akshare_quote
label: akshare_quote
description: Read actual explicitly selected Eastmoney or Tencent single-stock quote snapshot; polling observation, not an exchange tick stream.
